title: Rippleburst
summary: Rippleburst is a high-power spell that creates a powerful stream of yellow energy. This spell is so powerful that it can be used to heavily damage and defeat Titans such as Sabriel.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
The Professor used Rippleburst on the rooftop of Dante Vale's house whilst attacking Lok Lambert, but missed due to being blinded by Lok's Darkfog. Later, when the team were ambushed by Shauna and Wind, she used Rippleburst on Lok, allowing Dervish to paralyze him and for her to steal Eathon Lambert's journal and the Amulet of Will.[The Secret of Two Generations] 

The Professor again used this spell twice against Sophie Casterwill's Sabriel, when she was refusing to return to her amulet due to the effect of Dominator's spikes. The first Rippleburst damaged the already injured Sabriel (due to the Professor's Poisonfang) while the second apparently took her out for good, her amulet being destroyed.[The Mission]

In the search for Nostradamus' Scrying Glass, Hoffman used the spell in the Tower of Nostradamus to knock out Annette. He later used it in Nostradamus' hidden observatory at the same museum to defeat Sophie's Feyone. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

While the Huntik team was trying to complete the Call of the Casterwill mission, 50 kilometers northeast of Mexico City, Kiel attacked Dante Vale using Rippleburst, but the latter countered it with Touchram, resulting in a shockwave that knocked Kiel back. [The Titan in the Temple of Sun]

Shauna cast Rippleburst on both hands (though without mentioning Doublespell) to target Sophie inside the Phoenix Volcano, but Powerbonded Sabriel protected her Seeker by getting in the way of the spell, going back to her amulet.[The Phoenix's Ashes]

This spell was used by Wilder against Sophie when the Huntik team were raiding the Professor's castle, trying to complete The Professor's Dossier mission. She managed to dodge it.[An Ally from the Organization]
